title: MRL ReviewVerdict (untrusted)
description: The ONLY object Codex returns in the Minimum Reliable Loop. It is UNTRUSTED and carries a verdict, a human-readable rationale, and references to CONTROLLER-ISSUED evidence ids, and nothing else. It has no SHAs, origin, branch, model or executable identity, no gate/test results and no digests; the controller constructs the git-bound CodexDecision from its own observed facts (D-024-R502/R503). additionalProperties is false. verdict APPROVE is only an untrusted reviewer opinion and never itself produces a COMPLETE/advance decision (D-024-R504); each evidence_ref_id must match an id the controller issued for this review. This file is deliberately flattened to the provider's strict structured-output subset (M0-T143, D-024-R702; the provider 400-rejects e.g. uniqueItems with invalid_json_schema, param text.format.schema): only object/property types, enum, required fields, the array item type, and additionalProperties:false. Every removed bound (nonempty and maximum rationale length, evidence-ref count, per-id length, uniqueness) is enforced controller-side in ReviewVerdict.from_provider (D-024-R703).
